name: la1
style: Flat 2D side view illustration from a children's picture book about animals that are now extinct. {subject}, the whole animal visible, cute and friendly with a happy face, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key magenta (#FF00FF) background. No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only. Every colour has a second, slightly darker flat shade on its lower or shadow side, giving a simple two-tone shading. Clean simple shapes. No pink, purple or magenta anywhere on the animal. No text, no ground, no grass, no shadow, no scenery.

items.dodo: A single Dodo bird standing on two short yellow legs facing right seen from the side, a plump round grey bird with a big hooked yellow and green beak, small wings and a curly white tuft of tail feathers
items.thylacine: A single Thylacine Tasmanian tiger standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a dog-like animal with a long stiff tail, sandy yellow brown fur with dark brown stripes across its back and rump
items.moa: A single giant Moa standing on two long thick legs facing right seen from the side, a very tall flightless bird with a long neck, a small head, no wings, shaggy brown feathers
items.quagga: A single Quagga standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a zebra relative with brown and white stripes only on its head, neck and front, a plain brown back and white legs, a short dark mane
items.great-auk: A single Great Auk standing upright on two short black legs facing right seen from the side, a penguin-like black and white seabird with a big deep black beak with thin white grooves and a white spot in front of its eye
items.clouded-leopard: A single Formosan clouded leopard standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a medium sized wild cat with a very long thick tail, short legs, golden tan fur with big dark cloud-shaped blotches
